professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate her development across cognitive, motor, language, and social-emotional domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed emerging developmental strengths in social engagement and learning potential, while identifying needs in fine motor coordination, attention and focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. These developmental delays impact her functional performance and daily activities, necessitating a structured, multidisciplinary intervention approach. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to enhance fine motor skills and support attention regulation and communication. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving speech therapy and behavioral support services will be essential to address Sabrina's comprehensive needs and ensure effective parental involvement and education. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be critical to tracking her progress, allowing for the timely adjustment of intervention strategies. With consistent, evidence-based interventions, Sabrina is anticipated to make significant gains in her developmental trajectory.
